description: From producing Roisin Murphy's debut album Ruby Blue to remixing hundreds of the best artists over the years and running the BBC Radiophonic Workshop, Matthew Herbert's remix of 'Beware The Stranger' is a cerebral dance floor journey from its gothic ambience to its exploding drum and vocal crescendo. Ripe for the dancefloor and home listening alike!
